description: 黑方中间捉后，再应对换子
explanation_en: Black inserts an attack on the undefended queen before dealing with the rook threat.

intro.popup: 💡 中间招：白后a7是挂子。黑方不急着应对Rd5威胁，先Rd7！中间捉后——白后被迫逃跑！
intro.popup_en: 💡 Intermediate move: White's queen on a7 is undefended. Instead of immediately answering the threat of Rd5, Black plays Rd7! to attack the queen and force it to move.

outro.popup: ✅ 要点：Rd7！中间捉无根白后——白后必须逃，黑方主动争取了时间和子力优势！
outro.popup_en: ✅ Key idea: Rd7! is an intermediate attack on the undefended queen. White must move it, giving Black time and a material advantage.

moves.popup: 黑车Rd7！中间招——直接攻击无根的白后a7（挂子），强迫白后先应对！
moves.popup_en: Rd7! An intermediate move that directly attacks White's undefended queen on a7, forcing it to respond first.

moves.popup: 白后Qe3——被迫逃离，a7挂子威胁解除！黑方中间招成功争取了主动！
moves.popup_en: The queen is forced to e3. The threat to the queen on a7 is gone, and Black has gained the initiative with the intermediate move.

moves.popup: 黑马Nf4！现在轮到黑方发展，攻击Qe3——中间招使黑方完全掌握主动！
moves.popup_en: Nf4! Black develops while attacking the queen on e3. The intermediate move has given Black full control of the initiative.
